high_level_description: The image is a meme that humorously depicts the frustration of a gamer when the game becomes too challenging. The top part of the image contains text that reads: "When the game starts getting hard so I start mashing buttons." Below this text, there is another line that says: "My controller:" The bottom part of the image features an anime-style illustration of a character with dark hair styled in two buns on either side of their head. The character has a distressed expression, with furrowed brows and a slightly open mouth, as if they are struggling or complaining.
